stem:
Meena's mother is choosing a material for the handle of a cooking pan.
The handle should not become hot quickly while the pan is on the stove.
Which material should she choose for the handle?

options.text: copper, because it is a good conductor of heat
steel, because it lets heat pass through it easily
wood, because it is a poor conductor of heat
aluminium, because it transfers heat quickly to the hand

teacher.key_rationale: A pan handle must reduce heat flow from the hot pan to the hand, so an insulator (poor conductor) is needed. Wood is the only poor conductor listed; copper, steel and aluminium are all good conductors and would heat up quickly. Key: C.
